name: twig-language-2
description: Snippets, Syntax Highlighting, Hover, and Formatting for Twig

twig-language-2.formatting.description: Enable Twig document and selection formatting. Changes apply immediately.

twig-language-2.braceLine.description: If true an empty line will be inserted after opening curly braces and before closing curly braces.
twig-language-2.braceLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.bracePadding.description: Inserts a space after the start of a container and before the end of the container if the contents of that container are not indented; such as: conditions, function arguments, and escaped sequences of template strings.
twig-language-2.bracePadding.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.braceStyle.description: Emulates JSBeautify's brace_style option using existing Pretty Diff options.
twig-language-2.braceStyle.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.braces.description: Determines if opening curly braces will exist on the same line as their condition or be forced onto a new line.
twig-language-2.braces.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.indentStyle.description: Use the current document indentation options, or explicitly override them with spaces or tabs.

twig-language-2.tabSize.description: Indent width. 0 uses the current document tab size, including language and editor overrides.

twig-language-2.methodChain.description: When to break consecutively chained methods and properties onto separate lines. A negative value disables this option. A value of 0 ensures method chains are never broken.
twig-language-2.methodChain.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.newLine.description: Append a final line ending after a complete tag when missing. Literal text tails and ignored regions are preserved.

twig-language-2.vertical.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.11.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language-2.wrap.description: Preferred width for HTML attributes and embedded code. 0 leaves HTML attribute wrapping unchanged and uses 80 for embedded code. Literal text is never reflowed.

twig-language-2.embeddedFormatting.description: Format safely parseable script/style bodies with bundled Prettier. Ambiguous Twig-generated bodies stay unchanged.

twig-language-2.ignore.description: Skip formatting matching file paths. Supports *, ** and ? globs, for example **/vendor/** or legacy.twig.

twig-language-2.formatTimeout.description: Maximum formatting time in milliseconds. Timeout cancels the worker and returns no edits.
